title: Example Usage
text: "typst" backend reproduces LaTeX’s TopicLongTable gave: listing sorted one “topic” columns (example subject, analyte) prints topic value , group header rows, instead repeating every row. group runs onto next page, column header current topic repeat top page, reader never sees page data idea subject belongs . Declare topic columns topic_cols; underlying table must already sorted : Concentrations subject Without topic_cols, "typst" backend ordinary table whose column header repeats every page. backends ignore topic_cols gracefully: named columns stay ordinary columns, values just repeat every row. Column alignment defaults right numeric columns left everything else; override tabtibble_align attribute (named character vector "left", "right", "center") set table calling new_tab_tibble(): "typst" backend frames data every table rule column header, repeats header every page, rule end table. Four attributes table adjust ; backends ignore . tabtibble_header_cols number leading columns label rows; vertical rule separates rest: tabtibble_widths sets column widths Typst track sizes: "auto", length "3cm" ".5in", fraction remaining width "2fr". Name every column, give widths column order: tabtibble_topic_labels = TRUE shows topic header “: ” (“subject: S001”) rather value alone, topic row says : tabtibble_typst_raw names columns whose cells Typst markup, equation, written without escaping. literal text cells must escaped caller. backends, markdown fallback outside Quarto, column escaped like , markup shows text:
code: conc <-   tibble::tibble(     subject = rep(c("S001", "S002"), each = 3),     time    = rep(0:2, times = 2),     conc    = c(0, 5.1, 4.3, 0, 6.0, 5.2)   )  d_tab_topic <-   tibble::tibble(     table      = list(conc),     caption    = "Concentrations by subject",     label      = "conc-by-subject",     topic_cols = list("subject")   ) %>%   new_tab_tibble()  options(tabtibble.backend = "typst") knit_print(d_tab_topic) attr(conc, "tabtibble_align") <- c(subject = "left", time = "center", conc = "right") d_tab_topic_aligned <-   tibble::tibble(table = list(conc), caption = "Aligned columns", topic_cols = list("subject")) %>%   new_tab_tibble() params <- tibble::tibble(Parameter = c("cmax", "tmax"), Value = c(5.2, 1.0)) attr(params, "tabtibble_header_cols") <- 1 attr(params, "tabtibble_widths") <- c(Parameter = "auto", Value = "1fr") attr(conc, "tabtibble_topic_labels") <- TRUE names_tab <- tibble::tibble(Parameter = c("r.squared", "lambda.z"), Name = c("$r^2$", "$lambda_z$")) attr(names_tab, "tabtibble_typst_raw") <- "Name"

title: tabtibble 0.0.2.9000
text: "typst" backend frames table’s data rule column header (repeated header every page) one end table. Attributes table adjust : tabtibble_header_cols (number leading columns label rows, separated rest vertical rule), tabtibble_widths (Typst column widths, "auto", "3cm", "2fr"), tabtibble_topic_labels (TRUE shows topic header “: ”), tabtibble_typst_raw (columns whose cells Typst markup, $r^2$, written without escaping). knit_print() now detects whether rendering Quarto plain R Markdown/knitr (knitr::opts_knit$get("quarto.version"), falling back QUARTO_PROJECT_ROOT/QUARTO_DOCUMENT_PATH environment variables). Quarto, behavior unchanged: table keeps crossref div ("typst" backend makes sense , now falls back "markdown" backend outside Quarto). plain R Markdown, div skipped – rendered plain Pandoc show literal, uncaptioned text – table instead gets ordinary caption output target understands: knitr::kable()’s caption markdown backend (native format detected target – detect_output_target() reports "typst", "latex", "html", "docx", "" – rather always Markdown pipe table), tinytable/gt/flextable’s captioning. keeps older Rmd reports working. New tabtibble.render_mode tabtibble.output_target options force detected mode/target (mainly tests, detection wrong environment). knit_print() longer requires results='asis' chunk header. default (tabtibble.knitr.auto.asis, TRUE), rendered markdown returned knitr::asis_output() – mechanism pander uses knitr.auto.asis option – knitr inserts directly whatever chunk’s results setting. Set options(tabtibble.knitr.auto.asis = FALSE) go back writing directly cat() (need results='asis', warns missing). Breaking: print_tabtibble()’s S3 generic longer declares caption formal, calling directly needs none; default method still accepts caption (now defaulting NULL) R Markdown mode captioning . custom print_fun passed knit_print.tab_list() still receives caption ; wrote print_tabtibble method expecting required caption formal default, give default instead. new_tab_tibble() gains optional label column (Quarto label, without tbl- prefix). absent, stable label derived table’s caption, re-rendering report reproduces labels. knit_print.tab_tibble() / knit_print.tab_list() now wrap table fenced Div (::: {#tbl-<label>} ... :::) @tbl-<label> resolves , Quarto report rendered Typst PDF engine, table appears Typst list tables (#outline(target: figure.(kind: "quarto-float-tbl"))). New tabtibble.backend option selects plain data.frame table rendered: "markdown" (default, via knitr::kable(), extra dependency), "tinytable", "gt", "flextable", "typst". table already built one packages, table1, printed via knit_print() method regardless option. missing backend package raises classed tabtibble_missing_package condition. New "typst" backend, topic_cols column new_tab_tibble(), reproduce LaTeX’s TopicLongTable natively Typst: table sorted one “topic” columns (example subject, analyte) prints topic value , group header rows, column header current topic repeat top page group continues onto (Typst’s table.header(level = ...), verified installed Typst 0.14.2). new_tab_tibble() validates topic_cols names real columns table already sorted . Column alignment defaults right numeric columns left otherwise, overridable tabtibble_align attribute table. backends ignore topic_cols, columns just repeat values every row. new_tab_list() now also accepts gt, tinytable, flextable objects already built (previously data.frame-like table1 objects). Caption cell text containing Typst-significant characters (* _ # @ $ < > \ [ ]` backslash) now escaped render literally Typst report. print_tabtibble.default() longer uses pander; pander dropped Suggests.
